model_claims.text: EqualityHashKey.__eq__() compares the wrapped items without considering the hash produced by its configured key strategy.
model_claims.source_quote:
`EqualityHashKey.__eq__()` compares the wrapped items without considering the
hash produced by its configured key strategy.

model_claims.text: Two EqualityHashKey instances with different key strategies can be equal while having different hashes, causing a set to treat them as distinct.
model_claims.source_quote:
a = EqualityHashKey(len, [1, 2])
b = EqualityHashKey(lambda value: 3, [1, 2])
assert a == b                 # current behavior
assert hash(a) != hash(b)     # 2 versus 3
len({a, b})                   # 2 despite the equality result

model_claims.text: After the change, equality requires matching hashes as well as equal wrapped items or matching class default markers.
model_claims.source_quote: Require matching hashes as well as equal wrapped items / matching class default markers.

model_claims.text: Different key strategies that produce the same hash and equal wrapped items can still compare equal, preserving dictionary lookup for equivalent key functions.
model_claims.source_quote: Different key strategies with matching hashes and equal items can still compare equal, so independently created equivalent key functions continue to support dictionary lookup.

model_claims.text: Default wrappers continue to work with unhashable items after the change.
model_claims.source_quote: Default wrappers still work with unhashable items.

model_claims.text: For unrelated operand types, __eq__ returns NotImplemented, letting Python's reflected comparison protocol handle the comparison.
model_claims.source_quote: For unrelated operand types, return `NotImplemented` and propagate it through `__ne__`, allowing Python's reflected comparison protocol rather than inspecting arbitrary objects as hash-key wrappers.

model_claims.text: The change in comparison semantics applies only when the previous behavior was inconsistent with hashing or blocked reflected equality.
model_claims.source_quote: This changes comparison semantics only when the existing helper was inconsistent with hashing or blocked reflected equality.

model_claims.text: Equality now evaluates the configured hash strategies (no performance improvement is claimed).
model_claims.source_quote: No performance improvement is claimed; equality now evaluates the configured hash strategies.
